record.question:
What led to the traditional practice of carrying ar hmui zum when traveling to a wedding in another
    village?
options: To protect the wedding party from wild animals along the forest trails
To avoid over-burdening and exhausting the food resources of the hosts
To present it as a formal token of respect to the bride’s parents
To use it as a symbolic prop during the evening celebrations
